registryBasis: The official Renhua County Natural Resources Bureau guide is a Shaoguan-area first-party publication describing Shaoguan's map-based real-estate search service, including cadastral/house-map browsing and address search. It establishes a local registration-service channel, not open machine-readable parcel geometry.
assessment: The official Shaoguan service is documented but protected by Guangdong unified identity authentication. Anonymous requests did not produce a parcel ID, schema, CRS, or polygon. No GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime readiness remains held.
